body: I know of few afflictions more persistent than discouragement. It’s like a debilitating disease. Rare is the person who can resist or overcome it alone.
If we look closely, we will discover four causes for Nehemiah’s discouragement.

Perhaps today you find yourself standing before the door of opportunity or change. Your strength has run out. Your confidence has faded. Your vision has grown dim. Wait! You may be on the verge of the greatest years of your life. On the other side of that barrier—if you just keep pressing on, doing what you know to be right—the reward of faithfulness awaits you.
